BN254 base-field constants and arithmetic, including serialization, Montgomery conversion, inversion, and square root.

# Purpose
This file defines low-level arithmetic support for the BN254 base field `Fp`. It includes field constants such as `fd_bn254_const_p`, `fd_bn254_const_one_mont`, `fd_bn254_const_b_mont`, and exponent values used for square root and inversion. It also defines helpers for byte conversion, sign and infinity flags in serialized values, and checks for valid field elements against the prime modulus `p`.

The file also implements core field operations on `fd_bn254_fp_t`, including copy, equality, addition, subtraction, negation, halving, multiplication, squaring, exponentiation, inversion, and square root. Most arithmetic uses Montgomery form and calls functions from `fiat-crypto` through `bn254_64.c`. The code is intended as an internal implementation file for BN254 field math, not as a standalone executable.
